_comment: Story-title leaf -> library-index.json catalog name. Single source of truth, consumed by catalog-map.ts (the docs block) and gen-component-pages.mjs (the index links). Each mapping was verified against the component the story actually imports from @wakecap/core-ui. Checked first, before exact/normalized matching, so it can also CORRECT a wrong exact match (e.g. Sidebar).
_group_space_case: Title differs from catalog key only by spacing/casing.
_group_chart_family: All chart-type pages render the one Chart container (@wakecap/core-ui/chart).
_group_map_family: All map pages render the one Map component (@wakecap/core-ui/map).
_group_core_widgets: Story title uses the plain name; the component is a Core* entry it imports.
_group_sidebar: Disambiguate: 'Sidebar' page renders the CoreAppSidebar widget; 'Sidebar Primitive' renders the generic Sidebar primitive. (Corrects a wrong exact-match.)
